custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the ball. AI often generates gibberish text that looks correct at a glance but fails character-level inspection. Also, verify that the stitching maintains consistent thickness and elevation throughout the curve; AI often thins out or merges stitches at the edges of the sphere.
